_note: The tuning garage (src/app/garage): upgrades for a car you own, three stages each, bought one stage at a time. A stage costs costPct % of the car's price (at least minCost AED, rounded to AED 100). boost is the total gain at each stage (percent): engine → top speed, turbo → acceleration, tyres → grip in the corners; they change how the car drives at the Autodrome (lib/autodrome perfOf). Stages stay with the car. Prices are enforced in car_tuning_rule() (*_race_garage_tracks.sql; checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs).

parts.name: Engine remap
parts.blurb: An ECU remap, a freer exhaust and a cold-air intake: more power at the top end.

parts.name: Turbo
parts.blurb: Bigger turbos and more boost: it pulls harder out of every corner.

parts.name: Tyres and suspension
parts.blurb: Stickier tyres and stiffer, lower suspension: take the corners faster without running wide.
